title: Email Marketing Benchmarks & Industry Statistics | Mailchimp

facts.fact: In Mailchimp's benchmark table, the average open rate for the Business + Finance industry is 31.35%.
In Mailchimp's benchmark table, the average click rate for the Business + Finance industry is 2.78%.
In Mailchimp's benchmark table, the average unsubscription rate for the Business + Finance industry is 0.15%.
In Mailchimp's benchmark table, the average open rate for the Non-Profits industry is 40.04%.
In Mailchimp's benchmark table, the average click rate for the Non-Profits industry is 3.27%.
In Mailchimp's benchmark table, the average unsubscription rate for the Non-Profits industry is 0.18%.
In Mailchimp's benchmark table, the average open rate for the Education + Training industry is 35.64%.
In Mailchimp's benchmark table, the average click rate for the Education + Training industry is 3.02%.
In Mailchimp's benchmark table, the average unsubscription rate for the Education + Training industry is 0.18%.
In Mailchimp's benchmark table, the average open rate for the Ecommerce industry is 29.81%.
In Mailchimp's benchmark table, the average click rate for the Ecommerce industry is 1.74%.
In Mailchimp's benchmark table, the average unsubscription rate for the Ecommerce industry is 0.19%.
In Mailchimp's benchmark table, the average open rate across all users is 35.63%.
In Mailchimp's benchmark table, the average click rate across all users is 2.62%.
In Mailchimp's benchmark table, the average unsubscription rate across all users is 0.22%.
Mailchimp states that the benchmark data on the page was last updated in December 2023.
facts.quote: The data provided on this page was last updated in December 2023 and may vary from email marketing benchmarks data provided within the Mailchimp application.

facts.fact: Mailchimp's benchmark calculations only included campaigns that were sent to at least 1,000 subscribers.
facts.quote: We only tracked campaigns that went to at least 1,000 subscribers.

facts.fact: Mailchimp recommends using no more than 9 words and 60 characters in an email subject line.
facts.quote: We recommend you use no more than 9 words and 60 characters.

facts.fact: Mailchimp's research indicates that a subject line should use no more than 3 punctuation marks.
facts.quote: Our research shows that it’s best to use no more than 3 punctuation marks per subject line.

facts.fact: Mailchimp's research indicates that no more than 1 emoji should be used at a time in a subject line.
facts.quote: According to our research, you should use no more than 1 emoji at a time.
